title: The Moonbeam Celebration
virtue: Trusting Your Heart and Following Your Path
claude_note: Claude communicates via THOUGHT BUBBLES - his thoughts are narrated by the Narrator voice, not spoken directly

scenes.title: The Circle of Friends
scenes.setting: Ancient amphitheater with representatives from each chapter

lines.text: Sir James and Claude arrived at a beautiful moonlit amphitheater where all their friends from past adventures had gathered.
Look Claude! The dragon, the Wise Owl, the Garden Keeper - everyone is here! What's happening?
The moonlight grew brighter, and a gentle voice filled the air. 'Welcome, Sir James. Tonight, we celebrate you.'

scenes.title: The Moonbeam Path
scenes.setting: Silver moonbeam creating a glowing path

lines.text: A beautiful path of pure moonlight appeared before Sir James, stretching toward a glowing platform in the center.
Should I walk on the moonbeam, Claude? It looks so magical!
Claude nudged him forward gently. This was Sir James's moment to shine.

scenes.title: Remembering the Lessons
scenes.setting: Images of past adventures floating in the air

lines.text: As Sir James walked the moonbeam path, magical images of all his adventures floated around him like glowing memories.
I remember everything! The dragon's riddle about honor, the mirror's lesson about truth, the stars teaching me about dreams!
Each memory sparkled brighter as Sir James remembered the virtue he had learned.
Sir James reached into his pocket and found all the magical gifts he had received - the dragon scale, the owl feather, the star crystal.
They're all glowing together! It's like they're happy to be reunited!
The gifts rose into the air and began to swirl together, creating a beautiful rainbow of light.

scenes.title: The Knight's Medal
scenes.setting: Gifts transforming into a golden medal

lines.text: The swirling lights merged together and transformed into a beautiful golden medal shaped like a heart with a star in the center.
It's beautiful! All the lessons I learned became this?
'This is the Medal of True Knighthood,' said the moonlight. 'You have earned it with your kind and brave heart.'

scenes.title: Friends Celebrate
scenes.setting: All magical friends cheering and celebrating

lines.text: All the magical friends cheered! The dragon breathed sparkles, the fireflies danced, and the flowers bloomed with joy.
Thank you, everyone! I couldn't have learned these lessons without all of you!
Claude howled happily, and the whole amphitheater filled with the sound of celebration.
Then the moonlight shone directly on Claude. 'And you, faithful friend, deserve special recognition.'
Yes! Claude has been with me through everything. He's the best friend anyone could have!
A smaller medal appeared around Claude's neck - the Medal of Loyal Friendship. His tail wagged with pride.

scenes.title: A Knight's Promise
scenes.setting: Sir James and Claude under the full moon

lines.text: As the celebration continued, Sir James stood tall under the full moon, his medal glowing softly against his heart.
I promise to always use what I've learned to help others. That's what being a true knight means.
Claude stood proudly beside him, and together they looked up at the moon, ready for whatever adventure came next.
You've grown so much, my boy. Remember, the greatest adventures are still ahead. I'm so proud of you.
